description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping process" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" name="Three logistics companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitations" name="Invitation to make offers" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Arrange shipment" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Work in parallel" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Secretary clarifies who will do the shipping"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount" name="Amount" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Secretary invites three logistics companies to make offers"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Secretary selects one company"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingMerge" name="Shipping method selected" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Secretary writes a package label"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance" name="Is parcel insurance necessary?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Logistics department head takes parcel insurance"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" name="Insurance decision complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Warehousemen package the goods"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Everything is ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by the logistic company"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods prepared for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>amountCategory = 'large'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_NormalPost">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>amountCategory = 'small'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Insurance necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>insuranceNecessary = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Insurance not necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>insuranceNecessary = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
